title: Interview evidence record
description: Schema for data/interview_evidence/*.json. The claims[] fields map one-to-one onto the parameter card in elicitation_worksheet.md section 5, so transcription is mechanical. DF18 counts only records at status 'complete'; a record is written at 'pending_confirmation' and promoted to 'complete' when the interviewee has confirmed it.

role_category.description: The protocol's seven roles. The seventh, purchaser_contracting_authority, was added under revision R012 of 2026-09-07 together with the matching role in protocol.yaml; before R012 such a person logged as gpo_wholesaler_distributor (target_matrix.md sections 3 and 8).

status.description: pending_confirmation: transcribed and sent back to the interviewee, not yet confirmed. complete: confirmed, or the stated wait elapsed; only this counts toward DF18. no_reply: contacted, no answer, which is not a refusal.

parameter_definition_readback.description: The parameter definition read aloud, in their words back to you (card row 2). Not the closing attack.

challenge.description: The closing attack on this parameter, if there was one (worksheet section 9, rule C2). A claim row opened by the close carries this with low, base and high null.

units.description: Confirmed on the call before any number (worksheet rule A1). Enter 'n/a' for a claim row that carries no number.

entity_level.description: Confirmed on the call before any number: site, network, batch, event, year, group, supplier, order. Enter 'n/a' for a claim row that carries no number.

range_confidence_pct.description: Their stated confidence, as a percentage, that the truth lies between low and high (worksheet rule A3). Recorded rather than assumed, so ranges elicited at different confidences can be put on one scale before they enter a sweep.

widened.description: Whether the range widened after the single widening probe (worksheet rule A4), and what moved goes in rationale.

our_range_reaction.description: Their reaction when the study's own low, base and high were shown, which happens only after their first answer (worksheet rule A6).

direction_higher.description: What makes it higher in practice (worksheet rule A7).

direction_lower.description: What makes it lower in practice (worksheet rule A7).

basis.description: Drives the tier (worksheet section 6). 'impression' logs at tier 5 no matter who gives it.

rationale.description: Verbatim. A paraphrase cannot be audited later.

disagreement.description: The protocol's fifth required field for tier 4. Either the substance of a disagreement with another interviewee or a snapshot, or the explicit entry 'no other interviewee has answered this yet'. A blank fails the tier-4 test (worksheet rule T1). Every disagreement recorded here is also recorded as a contradicts token on both records (rule D3).
